entities.title: The same game in every browser and on the server
entities.summary: The engine must give bit-identical results everywhere.
entities.requirement: Engine code uses only + − × ÷ and exact helpers, its own sine and cosine, and random numbers only from its own seeded generator, so a game replays exactly in every browser and in the Worker, and two browsers online stay in step.
entities.measuredBy: The replay tests (a recorded one- or two-player game replays to the same scores; dsin and dcos agree with Math's), and the online fingerprint, compared between browsers every 120 steps.

origin.description: The repository's agent instructions: the games' engines must stay deterministic.

entities.title: Replays are cheap for the server
entities.summary: The Worker replays a whole game on every submission, so a replay must be fast.
entities.requirement: The README gives about 1 ms of replay per minute of play; games of up to two hours are accepted.
entities.measuredBy: Nothing measures it: no test times a replay (Rally's test/match.test.ts has such a test; Hivestorm has none).

origin.description: Hivestorm's README, How scores are checked.

entities.title: Everything from this origin
entities.summary: The page loads nothing from elsewhere except Cloudflare Web Analytics.
entities.requirement: The page's content security policy allows scripts, styles, images and connections only from icelander.net (and wss://icelander.net for online games), plus Cloudflare's analytics beacon; no framing, form submissions, plugins or base URL changes.
entities.measuredBy: public/_headers, read by Cloudflare's static assets; the scores page sets its own policy in worker/look.ts.

entities.title: Recordings stay small
entities.summary: A recorded game is a few kilobytes a minute.
entities.requirement: Controls are recorded as runs of identical frames, so a submission stays well under the Worker's 2,000,000-character limit for a game of over an hour.
entities.measuredBy: Nothing measures it; MAX_BODY_BYTES's comment states the estimate.
